summary: Dominari Holdings filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 disclosing that its board authorized a share repurchase program on September 16, 2026, permitting purchases of up to $5 million of outstanding common stock. Repurchases may occur via open-market transactions under Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18, with no fixed price, share count, or expiration stated. The board recommends no recommendation beyond authorization; no advisor is named. The program is discretionary and terminable at any time, with timing dependent on market conditions. Watch for execution pace relative to Nasdaq volume and any Rule 10b-18 pricing caps.
